title: It’s like duolingo for your own habits
author: Skaerexx

title: Smooth and clean
body: Nice animation and real implementation from the book + daily lessons and interesting articles by James Clear integrated in the app. The app does exactly what it promises to do and works extremely well, it’s very smooth and almost calming just by using it.
author: Sylvanovikof

title: Crazy Expensive / Bad UX
body:
I’ve tried this app and I really didn’t like the UX I was actually planning to delete it cause the UX was too bad. But last week they updated it and made the User experience better. So I continued using it.

However, I used to have 5 habits, and with the new updates I can only have 1 habit unless I pay for premium which is like 10 EUROS  A MONTH! That’s insaneeeeeeeeeee! There are plenty of simple habit tracking apps with much better and functional UX. 

Waste of money and it’s not even that good!
author: NotAnotherArchitect

title: Habits for leaders
body: I use the Atoms app to improve my habits as the leader of a nonprofit. I have found so useful to invite a professional partner as « accountability partner ».
author: mhuletbe

title: Too expensive
body: I loved the book. And it would help stick to a new habit but it’s way too expensive for the return on investment.
author: Joyc234

title: EXCELLENT APP!
body: I have found this app to be very useful in helping me stick to the daily new habits I am working on in order to creat my brand spanking new identity. Thank you so much Mr Clear for sharing your knowledge with us so we can improve the quality of our lives.
